**Job Description**

We are seeking a Senior IT Procurement Specialist to manage end-to-end procurement operations for IT hardware, software, and services. This role is responsible for sourcing, vendor coordination, purchase order management, and inventory oversight, with a strong focus on optimizing relationships with key VARs (Value-Added Resellers) such as Insight, CDW/CDM, SHI, and OEM partners like HP.

The ideal candidate has deep experience in IT procurement workflows, is highly organized, and can bridge procurement, asset management, and end-user enablement. This role will also play a critical part in device lifecycle management, including coordinating drop shipments, Intune enrollment, and ensuring seamless delivery of technology to end users.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage the full lifecycle of IT procurement, including quote requests, vendor comparisons, PO creation, and order tracking
* Partner with VARs (e.g., Insight, CDW/CDM, SHI) and OEMs (e.g., HP) to obtain competitive pricing, availability, and lead times
* Review and validate vendor quotes, ensuring alignment with standards, budgets, and technical requirements
* Create and manage purchase orders (POs), ensuring proper approvals, coding, and documentation
* Build and maintain strong vendor relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for escalations, sourcing, and issue resolution
* Monitor and maintain up-to-date inventory availability and product catalogs from VAR partners
* Oversee IT inventory management, including receiving, tracking, reconciliation, and lifecycle planning
* Collaborate with vendors (especially Insight) to develop and optimize device procurement and deployment programs
* Coordinate drop-ship processes directly from VARs to end users, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
* Support and/or execute device registration and provisioning workflows, including Microsoft Intune enrollment and user profile setup
* Partner with IT teams to ensure devices are configured according to enterprise standards and security policies
* Track and report on procurement metrics, including spend, vendor performance, and order status
* Ensure compliance with procurement policies, contracts, and internal controls
* Identify opportunities for cost savings, standardization, and process improvement

Required Qualifications

* IT procurement or sourcing experience in an enterprise environment
* Proven experience working with VARs such as Insight, CDW/CDM, SHI, and OEMs like HP
* Strong experience managing quotes, purchase orders, and vendor negotiations
* Hands-on experience with inventory management and asset tracking processes
* Familiarity with device lifecycle management, including procurement through deployment
* Experience supporting or coordinating Intune (or similar MDM) device enrollment and provisioning workflows
* Strong understanding of IT hardware (laptops, desktops, peripherals) and procurement best practices
* Proficiency in procurement and financial systems (e.g., Coupa or similar tools)
* Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience developing device-as-a-service (DaaS) or lifecycle programs with VAR partners
* Familiarity with Autopilot and zero-touch deployment models
* Experience working in a high-volume, multi-location environment
* Knowledge of contract management and vendor agreements
* Exposure to ServiceNow for request intake and workflow tracking

Soft Skills & Competencies

* Strong vendor management and relationship-building skills
* High attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and accountability
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement
* Strong collaboration skills across IT, Finance, and Procurement team

Bachelors - Business Administration, Bachelors - Industrial Engineering, Bachelors - Logistics, Bachelors - Supply Chain Management, Masters - Operations Management
